price_drawdown.detail: The price has fallen 47.5% peak-to-trough (2023-05-01 -> 2026-07-27) and has not regained that peak.

return_asymmetry.detail: Gains and losses are symmetric enough: weekly-return skew +0.06, tail ratio 1.00.

cash_engine.detail: The cash engine fell 71% from its 2019-06-30 peak to its 2022-06-30 trough and has since regained that peak — a cyclical engine, not a broken one.

stress.detail: The cash engine bent when the world tilted: the 2020 demand shock took owner earnings 21% below the prior peak (2020-06-30) and it came back; the 2022 rate shock took owner earnings 71% below the prior peak (2022-06-30) and it came back.

predictability.detail: This business can be forecast: annual revenue growth is typically 4 points away from its 6%/yr average and the operating margin is typically 2 points away from its 12% average — steady enough to be valued without a spreadsheet of assumptions.

financing.detail: Not measured — financing fragility: no twelve-month debt maturity on the latest balance sheet (no ingester in this repo maps the EDGAR tag; see the §3.6 provenance); no split history on this Bundle, so the raw share counts cannot be restated — a split and an issuance read identically and neither may be called dilution. Absent evidence is not safety (§7).

concentration.detail: This filer does not tag customer concentration, so this layer cannot see it — and silence here is not safety (§3.7); the cash-engine probe is what catches the same fragility by another route.
